models.name: ecommerce_customers
models.description: Registered customer accounts with email/password authentication credentials, including profile details like display name and phone number. Follows Snapshot Principle for immutable audit trail of changes across all fields. Key relationships: Child tables include ecommerce_customer_sessions, ecommerce_customer_password_resets, ecommerce_customer_email_verifications (all referenced in otherComponents).

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's unique email address for authentication. {@link ecommerce_customers.email is validated against format requirements and must be unique across all customer accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication with bcrypt implementation. Stored using modern password hashing standards without plaintext storage.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Display name visible to other users (up to 50 characters, optional). Validated against prohibited terms and reflected immediately upon update.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Phone number with international E.164 format for contact (optional). Normalized and validated using standard E.164 format across all address references.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was first created with precise UTC time recording.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated with precise UTC time recording.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was marked for deletion for soft delete implementation.

models.name: ecommerce_customer_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for customer authentication with 15-minute inactivity timeout and refresh support. Stores connection context for security auditing including IP address, browser headers, and referrer information. Each session is bound to a single customer for audit tracking and security enforcement. The expired_at field ensures token security by automatically marking tokens as invalid after 15 minutes of inactivity.

Session tokens use JWT format with 30-minute expiration (15-minute inactivity + 15-minute buffer), providing security against replay attacks while allowing reasonable user sessions.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address for connection tracking.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current URL path when session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Previous URL path before session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session token was generated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session token expires (15 minutes after creation).

models.name: ecommerce_customer_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens with expiration for 24-hour window. Stores secure tokens used for customer password resets with associated expiration and tracking data.

- Unique tokens prevent replay attacks
- Expiration ensures one-time use within 24-hour window
- References customer directly through foreign key
- Standard temporal fields enable audit tracking

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer associated with this password reset token. {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure random token used in password reset URL. Unique per request.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for token validity (24 hours after creation).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was last updated (typically same as creation for this immutable entity).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was deleted (if reset completed or expired).

models.name: ecommerce_customer_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for customer authentication. Each token enables user to confirm their email address via confirmation link with expiration period. Automatically records when confirmation was successful. Maintains soft delete for security audit trail.

This is a session-type table as it supports authentication flow for customer accounts, following email verification principles specified in business requirements.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer whose email is being verified. {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique token hash sent to customer's email for verification process.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when verification token expires (30 minutes after token generation).

plainFields.name: confirmed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when email was successfully confirmed (null until verified).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when email verification token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when email verification token data was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when verification token was marked for soft deletion.

models.name: ecommerce_sellers
models.description: Seller accounts with email/password authentication credentials and approval status tracking, representing distinct user types on the platform for business entities authorized to sell products.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address for seller account login. Must be unique and format valid for business email.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash securely stored for authentication. Used with bcrypt for salted hashing.

plainFields.name: approval_status
plainFields.description: Current approval status of the seller account: pending for new registration, approved for access to sell, rejected for registration with reason.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was marked for deletion (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_seller_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for seller authentication with device tracking, including IP address, device information, and session expiration details

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who owns this session. {actor}_id reference to ecommerce_sellers.id.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current URL for which the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referring URL that led to this session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp (security requirement).

models.name: ecommerce_seller_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for sellers with email verification workflow. Each token is unique and expires after 24 hours. Created when a seller requests password reset and used to reset password within time limit. Includes creation timestamp, expiration, and references to the seller account.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who requested the password reset. {@link ecommerce_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique token used to authenticate password reset. Generated as UUID and stored securely.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token expires (24 hours from creation).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the password reset record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was soft deleted.

models.name: ecommerce_seller_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for seller registration, tracking verification requests, expiration, and confirmation status. All tokens are linked to seller accounts through the ecommerce_sellers table, enabling verification flow for new seller account creation.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account being verified. {@link ecommerce_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Email verification token for security verification. Must be unique and expire after specified timeframe.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token expires (24-hour window from creation).

plainFields.name: is_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the email address has been successfully verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for audit trail. Nullable.

models.name: ecommerce_admins
models.description:
Admin accounts with elevated privileges and authentication security for system administration purposes.

This table stores authentication credentials and security-sensitive attributes for administrative users. The email field is uniquely constrained to prevent duplicate accounts, and password_hash stores securely hashed credentials. Temporal fields track creation/modification history with soft delete support for auditability.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for admin account authentication. Must use valid email format.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password using bcrypt with minimum 8-character complexity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was soft deleted (nullable for soft delete support).

models.name: ecommerce_admin_sessions
models.description:
Session tokens for admin authentication with multi-factor authentication support. Each record represents a valid JWT session token for admin accounts. The expired_at field is never nullable as a security measure to prevent session expiration issues.

This table is designed as a child table to ecommerce_admins with foreign key reference to admin profiles. Includes all required security details for authentication tracking including IP address, current URL, and referrer information.

**Critical Security Note**: expired_at must always be populated with a timestamp ensuring session expiration (never NULL) to prevent session hijacking vulnerabilities.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_admin_id
foreignFields.description:
Reference to admin account's {
@link ecommerce_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the user session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current URL for this session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referring URL for this session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was marked as deleted.

models.name: ecommerce_admin_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for admin accounts with security audit requirements. Each token is valid for 24 hours and used to reset an admin's password. Contains token value, admin reference with expiration timestamp and creation timestamp. Tokens are invalidated on use or expiration.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin requestor's {@link ecommerce_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Password reset token value stored in encrypted form.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the password reset token (24 hours after creation).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token record was last updated (e.g., when the token was used).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was invalidated (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_system_configs
models.description:
System-wide configuration parameters and default values for all components. 

This table stores all system-level configuration parameters as key-value pairs, with descriptions and timestamps. 

Configurations affect multiple business domains including:
- Order processing and management
- User experience and interface defaults
- Product catalog operations
- Shipping and delivery policies

Each configuration is managed through a dedicated administrative interface and requires approval before being deployed to production.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique key identifier for this configuration parameter.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Value for this configuration parameter.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description of what this configuration parameter does.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: ecommerce_system_statuses
models.description:
Current operational status of system components including health checks and service availability. Contains real-time indicators of component health state, tracking each component's operational status and the last time it was checked.

This table implements the Snapshot Principle by recording all data modifications in immutable form (via the general ecommerce_snapshots table), while this table itself serves as the operational view of system health across all domains. The health_score field provides a quantitative measure of system health for monitoring and alerting systems.

The status field (healthy, warning, unhealthy) follows standard monitoring terminology and is constrained to these values to ensure consistent interpretation and processing.

plainFields.name: component_name
plainFields.description: Name of the system component being monitored (e.g., 'product_catalog', 'order_processing', 'payment_gateway').

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current operational status of the component. Values are restricted to 'healthy', 'warning', or 'unhealthy' based on monitoring thresholds.

plainFields.name: health_score
plainFields.description: Numerical health score between 0-100 representing system health state. 100 = ideal, 0 = completely non-functional.

plainFields.name: last_check_timestamp
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent health check for this component.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of record creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last record update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of record soft deletion (null if not deleted).

models.name: ecommerce_snapshots
models.description: System-wide immutable storage for recording all data modifications according to the Snapshot Principle. Captures entity modification context, previous state, and temporal metadata for comprehensive audit trails and historical data analysis.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the snapshot entity.

plainFields.name: entity_type
plainFields.description: The name of the table where the entity modification occurred (e.g., 'ecommerce_products' or 'ecommerce_orders').

plainFields.name: entity_id
plainFields.description: The primary key value of the modified entity instance, referenced as a UUID.

plainFields.name: snapshot_data
plainFields.description: JSON-formatted string containing the previous state of the modified entity, including all relevant fields for comparison.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when this snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this snapshot (should be same as created_at, but maintained for consistency).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when this snapshot was logically deleted (if applicable). For audit purposes, this value is typically null.

models.name: ecommerce_categories
models.description: Main category definitions with parent-child hierarchy. Parent categories serve as top-level categories, and child categories are subcategories for product organization. Each category has a unique name and description.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent category's {@link ecommerce_categories.id} for one-level subcategory hierarchy.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique name of the category. Examples: 'Electronics', 'Wearables', 'Smartphones'

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the category's purpose and content. Examples: 'Category for all electronic products including phones, tablets, and accessories.'

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when this category was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when this category was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when this category was marked as deleted. Used for soft deletion.

models.name: ecommerce_products
models.description: Main product details including name, description, category reference, and base price. Products represent core business entities that users can independently create, search, filter, and manage across all shopping experiences. This table supports full search capabilities for product listings and integrates with product variants to display inventory and pricing.

foreignFields.name: categories_id
foreignFields.description: The product's category. {@link ecommerce_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name displayed to customers in search results and listings.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the product for customers' reference.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price for the product in USD, used for calculations in the shopping system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was last updated in the system.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was marked for deletion (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_product_variants
models.description: Product variants with unique SKU identifiers, price overrides, and stock quantities. Each variant belongs to a specific product and enables detailed product representation. Supports inventory tracking per variant.

foreignFields.name: products_id
foreignFields.description: Product this variant belongs to. {@link ecommerce_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Unique SKU for this variant, used to identify the variant uniquely across the system.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Override price for this variant (if null, the base product price is used).

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Current stock quantity available for this variant.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was soft-deleted (nullable for soft-delete tracking).

models.name: ecommerce_inventories
models.description: Immutable records of inventory quantity changes with reason and timestamp for stock tracking. Each record indicates a change in the quantity of a specific product variant, along with the reason for the change and the timestamp of the entry. This table follows the Snapshot Principle for tracking changes to inventory data.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The product variant this inventory change applies to. {@link ecommerce_product_variants.id}

plainFields.name: quantity_change
plainFields.description: Net change in inventory quantity (positive for restocking, negative for order fulfillment)

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Description of the inventory change reason (e.g. 'customer_order', 'restock')

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when inventory change was recorded

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when inventory change record was last modified (should equal created_at for immutability)

models.name: ecommerce_product_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable historical record capturing full state of product when changes occur, including all product attributes and modification timestamps.

This table implements the Snapshot Principle by recording every state change of products (name, description, category, base price) in a point-in-time format. Each snapshot entry contains a complete copy of the product state to preserve historical accuracy, making it suitable for audit trails, version comparisons, and change tracking without modifying the source product data.

Uses ecommerce_product_id to reference the source product for proper historical tracking of changes.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that this snapshot represents. {@link ecommerce_products.id}

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name as it existed at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description as it existed at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: category_id
plainFields.description: Category associated with product at time of snapshot. {@link ecommerce_categories.id}

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price of product at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was captured.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was last updated (typically same as created_at for snapshots).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was logically deleted (for soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_variant_snapshots
models.description: Historical state of product variants captured at time of modification, including option values, price, and stock data. Used for change tracking and audit purposes. Reference: {@link ecommerce_product_variants.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Related product variant's {@link ecommerce_product_variants.id.

plainFields.name: option_values
plainFields.description: Current option values (e.g., color: 'Red', size: 'Large').

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Price per item during snapshot creation (may differ from base price).

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Stock quantity recorded at this point in time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification (same as created_at for snapshots).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when record was logically deleted (not used for snapshots).

models.name: ecommerce_product_images
models.description: Product images, including main images and additional images for display in search results and wishlist. Images are tied to products for display purposes in listing views, search interfaces, and customer-facing views. Each image is associated with a single product version and remains immutable through product snapshot history.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_id
foreignFields.description: The product this image belongs to. {@link ecommerce_products.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL of the displayed image.

plainFields.name: caption
plainFields.description: Optional caption for the image, displayed on product views.

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: Whether this is the primary image for the product display.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of this image record creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to this image record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of deletion (soft delete). Null if not deleted.

models.name: ecommerce_product_variant_options
models.description: Stores individual option-value pairs for product variants (e.g., color=Red, size=Large). Each option is a separate row to comply with 1NF and enable flexible attribute management. This is a subsidiary table managed through its parent variant.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The variant this option belongs to. {@link ecommerce_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: option_key
plainFields.description: Key for this option (e.g., color, size).

plainFields.name: option_value
plainFields.description: Value for this option in the variant (e.g., Red, Large).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this option was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this option was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this option was logically deleted.

models.name: ecommerce_seller_profiles
models.description: Stores seller profile information including shop name, description, and logo URL for customer-facing displays. This table represents the primary seller identity data visible to customers, but is managed through seller accounts as a subsidiary entity.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owner seller's account, with {@link ecommerce_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: shop_name
plainFields.description: Name of the seller's shop. Minimum 3 characters, maximum 50 characters.

plainFields.name: shop_description
plainFields.description: Description of the seller's shop and business. Maximum 500 characters.

plainFields.name: logo_url
plainFields.description: URL reference to the seller's logo image. This field stores the location of the logo file without storing the actual image data.

models.name: ecommerce_seller_profile_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable history of seller profile changes with timestamp, actor ID, and before/after field values.

Includes complete records of all modified profile fields (shop name, description, logo) in both before and after states, along with the timestamp of the change and the actor who initiated it.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_seller_profiles_id
foreignFields.description: The seller profile being changed. {@link ecommerce_seller_profiles.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_sellers_id
foreignFields.description: The seller actor who made the profile change. {@link ecommerce_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: shop_name_before
plainFields.description: Shop name value before the profile change.

plainFields.name: description_before
plainFields.description: Description value before the profile change.

plainFields.name: logo_before
plainFields.description: Logo URI before the profile change (may be null if logo was deleted).

plainFields.name: shop_name_after
plainFields.description: Shop name value after the profile change.

plainFields.name: description_after
plainFields.description: Description value after the profile change.

plainFields.name: logo_after
plainFields.description: Logo URI after the profile change (may be null if logo was deleted, or new logo added).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile change occurred.

models.name: ecommerce_orders
models.description:
Main order header records including customer reference, order date, total amount (computed on query), and overall status derived from item statuses. Represents the core business entity for order management, requiring independent CRUD operations.

- Linked to customers (ecommerce_customers) as owner
- Status transitions validated by business rules (pending → processing → shipped → delivered)
- Order date and customer reference enable efficient querying for reports and user history

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_customers_id
foreignFields.description: Order owner's identity. {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: order_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when order was placed.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current order processing status. Valid values: pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp.

models.name: ecommerce_order_items
models.description: Represents individual line items within orders, capturing historical product variant details at the time of purchase. Each order line item corresponds to a single variant of a product, including quantity, purchase price, and current status. This table maintains the relationship between orders and product variants, supporting order modification, tracking, and status updates through the ordering lifecycle. Follows Snapshot Principle to preserve historical state of each line item as it transitions between statuses.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_order_id
foreignFields.description: The order this line item belongs to.

foreignFields.name: product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The product variant this line item references.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of this variant purchased in the order.

plainFields.name: price_at_purchase
plainFields.description: Price of the variant at the time of purchase, preserving historical value.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the line item in the order lifecycle (placed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this line item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this line item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of logical deletion (if applicable).

models.name: ecommerce_shipments
models.description:
Tracks shipping carrier and tracking information for grouped items from same seller per order. This table allows customers to view shipping status and tracking details for their orders.

Key business context:
- Represents the actual shipping event for items from the same seller within an order
- Supports shipment tracking through carrier and tracking number
- Captures shipping date and delivery estimates for customer experience
- Maintains shipment status for order status tracking

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_order_id
foreignFields.description: The order to which this shipment belongs. {@link ecommerce_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: carrier
plainFields.description: Shipping carrier name (e.g., 'FedEx', 'DHL', 'USPS').

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: The tracking number provided by the shipping carrier.

plainFields.name: shipping_date
plainFields.description: The date and time when the shipment was sent out.

plainFields.name: estimated_delivery_date
plainFields.description: The estimated date when the shipment will be delivered.

plainFields.name: actual_delivery_date
plainFields.description: The actual date when the shipment was delivered (if known).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the shipping (e.g., 'shipped', 'in transit', 'delivered', 'out for delivery').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was marked for deletion (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_cancellation_requests
models.description: Customer cancellation requests with status, reason, and timestamp. Allows customers to request cancellation of orders with specific reasons and track the status through approval workflow.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: The primary key identifier for the cancellation request.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: The order for which the cancellation was requested. {@link ecommerce_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who requested the cancellation. {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: The current status of the cancellation request (one of: pending, approved, rejected, completed).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: The reason given by the customer for requesting the cancellation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was marked for deletion (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_refund_requests
models.description:
Customer refund requests with status, reason, and timestamp. Managed as a subsidiary entity through order processing workflows. Each request is linked to an order via foreign key and reflects refund status (pending, approved, rejected).

Key relationships:
- Connected to parent order through ecommerce_orders
- Status field tracks refund processing state
- Timestamped operations for audit trail

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order this refund request is associated with. {@link ecommerce_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current refund status (pending, approved, rejected).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for requesting refund with justification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when refund request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when refund request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when refund request was deleted (for soft deletion).

models.name: ecommerce_carts
models.description:
Main cart container for customer shopping sessions, storing active cart instances with creation timestamps and user association.

This table represents the central shopping cart instance that customers actively manage during their shopping journey. The cart tracks all items added to it, current cart status, and user context. Multiple carts are possible per customer, with each representing a separate shopping session.

Relationship with ecommerce_customers: Each cart belongs to exactly one customer account, enabling user-specific cart management and session tracking.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who owns this cart. {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was soft-deleted. Null indicates active cart.

models.name: ecommerce_cart_items
models.description:
Cart line items containing product variants, quantities, and prices at time of addition for each shopping session.

- Each cart item represents a product variant added to a customer's cart at a specific price point.
- price_at_addition stores the price at time of addition (historical accuracy for pricing changes).
- Foreign key to ecommerce_carts for cart context.
- Foreign key to ecommerce_product_variants for product relationship.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_carts_id
foreignFields.description: Cart containing this item. {@link ecommerce_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_variants_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant associated with this cart item. {@link ecommerce_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of the product variant in the cart.

plainFields.name: price_at_addition
plainFields.description: Price of the product variant at time of addition (for historical accuracy).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when cart item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when cart item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when cart item was marked as deleted (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_cart_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time snapshots of cart state changes to maintain audit history of item additions, removals, and quantity modifications.

Captures the complete state of a shopping cart at the moment when it was modified, including customer information, cart status, and all item quantities. Enables historical analysis, rollback of cart modifications, and audit trails for system debugging.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Cart record this snapshot belongs to. {@link ecommerce_carts.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart snapshot was created (recorded by system).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart snapshot was last updated (same as created_at for snapshots).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart snapshot was deleted (if deleted, used for soft deletion).

models.name: ecommerce_addresses
models.description: Stores customers' shipping addresses with recipient name, phone, street, city, state, postal code, and country. Each address belongs to a specific customer and supports full address management for shipping purposes.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this address, references {@link ecommerce_customers.id}

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Recipient's full name for shipping

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Shipping contact phone number (E.164 format)

plainFields.name: street
plainFields.description: Street address line

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City name for delivery location

plainFields.name: state_province
plainFields.description: State or province code or name

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal or zip code for shipping

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country code or full name

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when address was first created

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when address was deleted (soft deletion)

models.name: ecommerce_default_addresses
models.description:
Tracks the current default address for each customer using foreign key references. This table is managed exclusively through customer entity operations and does not require standalone UI or API interface.

**Business Context**: Each customer can have exactly one default address, which determines the shipping address for their orders. The relationship is 1:1 between customer and default address. When a customer changes their default address, the previously associated default address is automatically updated but not deleted, maintaining historical address reference.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the address was set as default.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the default address was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the address was marked as deleted (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_wishlist_items
models.description:
Tracks items added to customer wishlists with product references, timestamps, and current price values. Each wishlist item belongs to a specific customer and product variant with current price at time of addition. Allows users to manage their wishlists independently with all necessary business context.

- Customer relationship: @link ecommerce_customers.id
- Product variant relationship: @link ecommerce_product_variants.id

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who added this item to their wishlist. {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant associated with this wishlist item. {@link ecommerce_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Current price of product variant at time of wishlist addition.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when item was added to wishlist.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when wishlist item was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when item was soft-deleted (null if active).

models.name: ecommerce_product_reviews
models.description:
Customer reviews and ratings for products. Each review includes a numerical rating (1-5), text comments, and references to both the associated product and the customer who provided the review. Reviews are created when customers submit feedback after purchase and serve as a key input for product recommendations and quality evaluation.

The table establishes relationships with both ecommerce_products (1:N) and ecommerce_customers (1:N), as a single product can have multiple reviews and a single customer can leave multiple reviews.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Belongs to the product being reviewed. {@link ecommerce_products.id}

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Review was written by this customer. {@link ecommerce_customers.id}

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Numerical customer rating for the product (1-5). Must be between 1 and 5 per business rules.

plainFields.name: comment
plainFields.description: Optional text comment from customer describing their experience with the product.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was soft-deleted (null means active).

models.name: ecommerce_product_review_snapshots
models.description: Immutable historical snapshots of product review modifications with before/after values and timestamps. Captures all changes made to product reviews for audit trail and history tracking. This table is append-only and should not be modified directly by users.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_review_id
foreignFields.description: The product review this snapshot belongs to. {@link ecommerce_product_reviews.id}.

plainFields.name: before
plainFields.description: JSON representation of the review before modification. Contains all review fields including rating, comment, and author ID.

plainFields.name: after
plainFields.description: JSON representation of the review after modification. Contains all review fields including rating, comment, and author ID.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was last updated (typically same as created_at for append-only tables).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was marked as deleted (for soft delete).
